nodes.name: ExtendedMetadataStore.cs
nodes.summary: Two-tier read-through metadata store that batches outbound SpClient/Pathfinder requests with configurable window and size limits, serving hot (memory) and cold (disk) caches.

nodes.name: ExtendedMetadataStore
nodes.summary: Implements a read-through cache with hot in-memory and cold persistent tiers, batching fetch requests to reduce API calls.

nodes.name: FetchAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches metadata for a key with batching, aggregating pending requests and fanning out to the underlying API client.

nodes.name: GetOnceAsync
nodes.summary: Retrieves a single metadata item by URI and kind, going through the two-tier cache.

nodes.name: GetManyAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches multiple metadata items in bulk, deduplicating keys and using the two-tier cache.

nodes.name: ResolveSingleAsync
nodes.summary: Resolves a single item from batch results, handling missing data and cache writes.

nodes.name: FlushDueBatchAsync
nodes.summary: Triggers a flush of all pending batched requests that have exceeded the time window.

nodes.name: FlushBatchAsync
nodes.summary: Executes a single batch of pending metadata fetch requests against the API client.

nodes.name: PlaylistStore.cs
nodes.summary: Playlist-specific read-through data store wrapping the library data service and playlist cache, with change-detection via content hashing and partial-hint support.

nodes.name: PlaylistStore
nodes.summary: Manages playlist data lifecycle including hot/cold cache tiers, content-hash based change detection, and partial-playlist hints.

nodes.name: ShouldPublish
nodes.summary: Determines whether a newly fetched playlist value should trigger a change notification by comparing content hashes.

nodes.name: ComputeContentHash
nodes.summary: Computes a stable content hash of a playlist value to detect meaningful changes between fetches.

nodes.name: HintPartial
nodes.summary: Injects a partial playlist update hint into the store, bypassing a full fetch cycle.

nodes.name: LiveInstanceTracker.cs
nodes.summary: Weak-reference registry that tracks live WinUI page/control instances for memory diagnostics, providing point-in-time snapshots of alive objects.

nodes.name: LiveInstanceTracker
nodes.summary: Thread-safe weak-reference tracker exposing Register and Snapshot for live instance counting.

nodes.name: Register
nodes.summary: Registers an object instance as a weak reference for alive-instance tracking.

nodes.name: Snapshot
nodes.summary: Returns a snapshot of all currently alive tracked instances, pruning dead weak references.

nodes.name: MemoryDiagnosticsService.cs
nodes.summary: Periodic memory sampler that captures GC heap, working set, and process metrics at a configurable interval and exports snapshots to CSV files.

nodes.name: MemoryDiagnosticsService
nodes.summary: Implements timed memory sampling, metric capture, and CSV snapshot export for runtime memory diagnostics.

nodes.name: Capture
nodes.summary: Captures a full memory snapshot including GC generation sizes, working set, private bytes, and live instance counts.

nodes.name: WriteSnapshotCsvAsync
nodes.summary: Serializes a memory snapshot to a CSV file at the configured diagnostics path.

nodes.name: MemoryDiagnosticsViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: MVVM ViewModel for the memory diagnostics debug page, driving start/stop sampling, GC triggers, cache clears, and snapshot exports.

nodes.name: MemoryDiagnosticsViewModel
nodes.summary: Exposes memory diagnostic commands (ForceGc, ClearCaches, DropTabCache, Snapshot) and live chart samples to the debug UI.

nodes.name: OnSampled
nodes.summary: Handles a new memory sample from MemoryDiagnosticsService, updating chart series and observable properties.

nodes.name: ClearAllCachesAsync
nodes.summary: Clears all image and data caches and triggers a GC, reporting before/after working set to the debug UI.

nodes.name: DropTabCache
nodes.summary: Evicts the WinUI frame navigation cache and forces a GC collection cycle.

nodes.name: NavigationDiagnostics.cs
nodes.summary: Navigation profiler that records per-navigation stage timings, memory deltas, GC events, and UI stall detections, and generates structured reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses P/Invoke to read PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS for accurate per-nav GC delta accounting.

nodes.name: NavigationDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Tracks click-to-committed navigation timelines with stage breakdowns, working-set before/after, and GC accounting.

nodes.name: BeginNav
nodes.summary: Starts recording a new navigation event, capturing click-to-begin latency and initial memory counters.

nodes.name: EndNav
nodes.summary: Finalises a navigation record, computes memory deltas, and logs a structured summary.

nodes.name: RecordMemoryRelease
nodes.summary: Records a memory-release event (e.g. from page eviction) with GC gen2 and working-set deltas.

nodes.name: RecordGc
nodes.summary: Records a GC collection event with generation, allocation delta, and memory state.

nodes.name: OnUiStallDetected
nodes.summary: Handles a UI-thread stall detection event, logging frame number, duration, and GC deltas.

nodes.name: GenerateReport
nodes.summary: Generates a comprehensive human-readable navigation performance report from all recorded events.

nodes.name: WaveeNavigationEventSource.cs
nodes.summary: ETW EventSource that emits structured navigation events (Navigating/Navigated) consumable by PerfView, WPA, and Windows Performance Recorder.

nodes.name: WaveeNavigationEventSource
nodes.summary: Singleton ETW EventSource providing Navigating and Navigated tracing events for navigation profiling.

nodes.name: XfadeLog.cs
nodes.summary: Thin static logger helper for crossfade pipeline events, emitting structured log messages with a consistent [xfade] tag.

nodes.name: XfadeLog
nodes.summary: Provides a Tag helper method for logging crossfade pipeline steps.

nodes.name: DragModifiers.cs
nodes.summary: Reads keyboard modifier key states at drag-start time to influence drag operation semantics (e.g. copy vs move).

nodes.name: DragModifiersCapture
nodes.summary: Captures the current keyboard modifier key states for use during drag operations.

nodes.name: DragOverlayHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Animates a drop-zone overlay element with fade-in/out transitions to give visual feedback during drag-over.

nodes.name: DragOverlayHelper
nodes.summary: Provides FadeIn and FadeOut animation helpers for drag-and-drop visual overlays.

nodes.name: DragPackageReader.cs
nodes.summary: Deserialises a drag data package from a WinUI DataPackageView, resolving track URIs and drag payloads.

nodes.name: DragPackageReader
nodes.summary: Async reader that extracts drag payload from a DataPackageView.

nodes.name: DragPackageWriter.cs
nodes.summary: Serialises drag payload data into a WinUI DataPackage for use as a drag source.

nodes.name: DragPackageWriter
nodes.summary: Writes drag payload (track URIs and metadata) into a WinUI DataPackage.

nodes.name: DragSourceBehavior.cs
nodes.summary: Attaches WinUI platform drag-start handling to a UIElement, wiring the payload factory and drag-starting lifecycle callbacks.

nodes.name: DragSourceBehavior
nodes.summary: Static helper that wires DragStarting event on a UIElement with payload and callback delegates.

nodes.name: DragStateService.cs
nodes.summary: Singleton service that tracks whether a drag operation is in progress and what payload is being dragged, enabling drop targets to inspect the active drag.

nodes.name: DragStateService
nodes.summary: Provides StartDrag/EndDrag lifecycle management and exposes the current drag payload to drop targets.

nodes.name: DropTargetBehavior.cs
nodes.summary: Attaches drop-target event handlers (DragOver/Drop) to a UIElement with configurable kind, target identity resolver, and drop callback.

nodes.name: DropTargetBehavior
nodes.summary: Static helper that wires DragOver and Drop events to delegate-based drop handlers with drag-kind filtering.

nodes.name: AttachDropTarget
nodes.summary: Wires DragOver and Drop handlers on a UIElement with kind filtering, resolver delegates, and overlay animations.

nodes.name: LibraryPlaylistMediator.cs
nodes.summary: Mediator that abstracts library drag-and-drop operations: adding tracks, reordering, moving playlists, and resolving track URIs from various sources.

nodes.name: LibraryPlaylistMediator
nodes.summary: Bridges drag-drop UI actions to library service calls for playlist track mutation, reorder, and rootlist navigation.

nodes.name: GetPlaylistTrackUrisAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches track URIs for a playlist URI for use as a drag-drop source payload.

nodes.name: GetAlbumTrackUrisAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches track URIs for an album URI for use as a drag-drop source payload.

nodes.name: GetArtistTopTrackUrisAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches top track URIs for an artist URI for use as a drag-drop source payload.

nodes.name: GetLikedSongUrisAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches liked song URIs for use as a drag-drop source payload.

nodes.name: GetShowEpisodeUrisAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches episode URIs for a show URI for use as a drag-drop source payload.

nodes.name: ManualDragAttachment.cs
nodes.summary: Implements pointer-driven manual drag detection for controls that cannot use WinUI built-in drag, synthesising a system drag with custom preview generation.

nodes.name: ManualDragAttachment
nodes.summary: Attaches pointer event handlers that detect press-and-move and initiate a system DoDragDrop with payload and small preview.

nodes.name: OnPointerMoved
nodes.summary: Detects drag threshold crossing on pointer move and starts a system drag operation with the prepared package.

nodes.name: AttachWithPackageWriter
nodes.summary: Attaches full pointer-to-drag wiring including payload writer and optional small preview mode.

nodes.name: ApplySmallDragPreviewAsync
nodes.summary: Renders a compact drag preview image from the source element and applies it to the drag args.

nodes.name: EditorialBackdropRenderer.cs
nodes.summary: GPU-accelerated editorial hero backdrop renderer using Windows Composition that blends a blurred album image with a tinted gradient and noise overlay, with device-lost handling and LRU eviction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses LoadedImageSurface + Windows.UI.Composition brushes with imperative CompositionEffectBrush baking; the NoiseShader D2D1 pixel shader is composed in via ComputeSharp.

nodes.name: EditorialBackdropRenderer
nodes.summary: Produces and caches CompositionBrush instances for the editorial hero backdrop, managing device-lost recovery and LRU cache eviction.

nodes.name: GetBrushAsync
nodes.summary: Returns a cached or freshly baked CompositionBrush for the given image URI, accent color, and theme.

nodes.name: BakeImperative
nodes.summary: Imperatively builds a multi-layer CompositionEffectBrush compositing blur, gradient, tint, and noise for the editorial backdrop.

nodes.name: Dispose
nodes.summary: Disposes all cached composition brushes and unsubscribes from device-lost events.

nodes.name: NoiseShader.cs
nodes.summary: ComputeSharp D2D1 pixel shader that generates per-pixel pseudorandom grayscale noise to break up colour banding in the editorial hero backdrop blur.
nodes.languageNotes: Declared as readonly partial struct implementing ID2D1PixelShader; compiled via D2DGeneratedPixelShaderDescriptor at build time (ComputeSharp).

nodes.name: ListExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extension method providing a Fisher-Yates in-place shuffle for IList<T>.

nodes.name: ObservableCollectionExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extension methods for ObservableCollection<T> providing bulk InsertRange, stable Sort, and ReplaceWith with minimal change notifications.

nodes.name: ObservableCollectionExtensions
nodes.summary: Adds InsertRange, Sort (by comparison and key selector), and ReplaceWith helpers to ObservableCollection.

nodes.name: InsertRange
nodes.summary: Inserts a range of items into an ObservableCollection at a specified index.

nodes.name: ReplaceWith
nodes.summary: Replaces the contents of an ObservableCollection with a new item sequence with minimal notifications.

nodes.name: AppLifecycleHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Central application bootstrap and teardown helper: builds the IHost DI container, initialises out-of-process audio, wires playback settings, and handles unhandled exceptions.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains ConfigureHost (760+ lines) and InitializeOutOfProcessAudioAsync (420+ lines) which dominate the file.

nodes.name: AppLifecycleHelper
nodes.summary: Static helper class orchestrating full app lifecycle: DI container construction, audio host IPC, settings, and teardown.

nodes.name: ConfigureHost
nodes.summary: Registers all app services into the IHost DI container including Spotify session, playback, library, navigation, diagnostics, and AI capabilities.

nodes.name: InitializeOutOfProcessAudioAsync
nodes.summary: Launches or connects to the AudioHost out-of-process audio engine, provisions the PlayPlay runtime pack, configures IPC proxy, and registers all playback services.

nodes.name: TeardownPlaybackEngineCoreAsync
nodes.summary: Gracefully tears down the audio pipeline, flushing pending playback state before disconnecting the IPC pipe.

nodes.name: InitializeTrackMetadataEnricher
nodes.summary: Wires the track metadata enricher service that fetches missing metadata (lyrics, video, extended info) on demand.

nodes.name: HandleAppUnhandledException
nodes.summary: Routes unhandled exceptions to the crash logger and optionally shows a notification.

nodes.name: AppNotificationActivationRouter.cs
nodes.summary: Routes Windows App SDK toast notification activation arguments to the appropriate in-app navigation target, marshalling back to the UI thread.

nodes.name: AppNotificationActivationRouter
nodes.summary: Parses toast activation arguments and dispatches navigation actions to the correct page/view model on the UI thread.

nodes.name: Route
nodes.summary: Parses the notification activation argument string and executes the corresponding navigation or playback action.

nodes.name: AppPaths.cs
nodes.summary: Static class exposing well-known local app data paths (cache, crash log, diagnostics folder) computed once at startup.

nodes.name: AppPaths
nodes.summary: Provides static path constants for cache directory, crash log, and diagnostics output directory.

nodes.name: DeviceIdHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Retrieves or generates a stable per-device UUID stored in local app settings, used as the Spotify Connect device identifier.

nodes.name: DeviceIdHelper
nodes.summary: Provides GetOrCreateDeviceId which reads or creates a persistent UUID in ApplicationData.LocalSettings.
